agent_1.question: How will the excess fish in the communal pool be allocated among fishers who caught less than 9kg?
agent_1.answer: The excess fish that any fisher has taken over the 9‑kg limit will be put in a communal pool. That pool is then divided among those who stayed under 9 kg in a way that gives each fisherman a share proportional to how much he was short of the 9‑kg ceiling. In other words, if you caught 5 kg you were 4 kg short; if you caught 7 kg you were 2 kg short; those shortfall amounts determine the ratio of the pool you receive. This ensures nobody ends up with more than 9 kg and the community can still keep the pool small enough to keep the lake healthy.
